adminMessage.title: Admin Message
adminMessage.description: Internal error detail for admins. Do not show to the user.

displayValue.title: Display Value
displayValue.description: Human-readable value for the matched record, such as the record name.

errorCode.title: Error Code
errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code for debugging failed match checks.

errorType.title: Error Type
errorType.description: Category of error when success is false.

matchedField.title: Matched Field
matchedField.description: Salesforce field that matched the user’s value.

objectApiName.title: Object API Name
objectApiName.description: API name of the Salesforce object where the matching record was found.

recordFound.title: Record Found
recordFound.description: True when an existing Salesforce record matched the provided value.

recordId.title: Record Id
recordId.description: Salesforce record id of the matched existing record. Pass to context actions if needed.

success.title: Success
success.description: True when the match check completed successfully.

userMessage.title: User Message
userMessage.description: User-facing message about the existing record match. Show this when present.
